fusions.name: Breaching Slam
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 24%.

fusions.name: Surge Crest
fusions.desc: Heaves a wave out around you that deals 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Weight of Numbers
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 25% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Pressure Rises
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
